item.title: 'This could be the end': dramatic rescue saves 23 stranded on ice shelf near Owen Sound
item.description: A total of 23 anglers became stranded when an ice shelf broke away from shore near Owen Sound on Sunday afternoon leading to an all-hands-on-deck rescue operation.

item.title: OFSAA wrestling silver
item.description: Local wrestler Taylum Sandy, from Six Nations Polytechnic Secondary School, recently captured silver at the Ontario Federation of School Athletic Associations wrestling championship. item.title: Calling young entrepreneurs: Applications open for Summer Company Student Grant Program
item.description: Local aspiring entrepreneurs are invited to apply for this year’s Summer Company Student Grant Program. The Brantford-Brant Business Resource Centre is accepting applications for those aged 15 to 29 who are considering starting and operating their own business this summer. Online applications are being accepted at Brantford.ca/SummerCompany until Friday, May 15. item.title: Medical products manufacturer moving from Hamilton to Brantford
item.description: A medical products manufacturer is moving from Hamilton to Brantford later this month with plans for growth. Blake Medical Group, founded by husband and wife Craig and Cathy Alexander in 2007, will consolidate its operations in a 64,000-square-foot facility at 60 Prince Charles Rd.
